composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Cast the shape of a sock puppet in mirror-polished metal, bending its neck into a compact arch. Keep the mouth only slightly open, lined with muted pink woven fabric, and place two small cork button eyes on top. The contrast between rigid chrome and soft puppet construction should feel amusing rather than unsettling. Reflect broad teal and cream shapes in the metal instead of a recognizable room. Show fabric weave inside the mouth and tiny cork pores in the eyes. Use a pale blush background with one shallow grounded shadow. The arched puppet occupies the central circle of the square, with no human hand, teeth, tongue, text, or additional objects.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
